record.dic_text:
03864 Luwbiy {loo-bee'} 或 Lubbiy (#但 11:43|) {loob-bee'}

源於字根已不使用的種族名稱, 意思是"乾渴"; 專有名詞

欽定本 - Lubim 3, Libyan 1; 4

利比亞人 = "空虛的" (#但 11:43|)
         = "受苦的" (#耶46:9|)
1) 住在北非埃及以西的一個民族

03864 Luwbiy {loo-bee'} or Lubbiy (Dan. 11:43) {loob-bee'}

partrial from a name probably derived from an unused root meaning
   to thirst;; n pr

AV - Lubim 3, Libyan 1; 4

Libyans = "empty-hearted (Dan. 11:43)"
        = "afflicted (Jer. 46:9)"
1) a people of northern Africa west of Egypt
